reasoning: Shows a bitten chocolate chip cookie with a diagonal slash through it, the standard UI metaphor for blocking/clearing browser cookies or literally avoiding cookies/sweets. It fits a narrow but real set of tech privacy tasks, web development checks, and no-sugar diet rules, though the slash blocks half the chocolate chips so at tiny sizes a viewer must look twice to see the bitten edge.
